items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize asset maintenance schedules using completed service
items.description:
Business value
Asset maintenance is most effective when service intervals reflect how equipment is actually used and maintained. Static schedules that continue from an assumed date or meter value can cause an organization to service an asset more often than necessary after early maintenance or wait too long after late, partial, or usage-intensive service.
Feeding completed maintenance activities, actual completion dates, and meter readings back into the maintenance plan recalibrates future requi

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Forecast planned maintenance demand
items.description:
Business value
Maintenance demand often becomes visible to service operations only after work orders are created, leaving limited time to prepare capacity and materials. A forward-looking maintenance forecast gives organizations earlier visibility into expected work so they can anticipate labor, skills, parts, and scheduling demand across the asset population.
This supports more proactive operational planning and helps teams identify periods of concentrated demand before they result in resource

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Forecast asset usage to predict maintenance due dates
items.description:
Business value
Usage-based maintenance aligns service with the work an asset has actually performed, but a current meter reading alone does not tell the organization when the next threshold will be reached. Forecasting the asset's expected usage rate converts meter-based maintenance from a reactive trigger into a forward-looking planning signal.
Maintenance and reliability teams can use the projected due date to plan labor, parts, capacity, and customer downtime before the threshold is reached.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Plan asset maintenance using time, actual usage, and service sequences
items.description:
Business value
Organizations can maintain assets according to how the equipment ages, how much it is actually used, and which service activities have already been completed. A flexible maintenance schedule helps avoid servicing lightly used equipment too often while reducing the risk that heavily used equipment operates beyond its required maintenance interval.
Usage-based schedules connect maintenance directly to meter readings recorded for the individual asset. This allows work to be driven by

items.description: Microsoft Teams preserves @mentions and shared contacts when you copy and paste messages in chats and channels. Instead of defaulting to plain text, Teams intelligently displays an @mention, shared contact, or plain text based on where the content is pasted, reducing manual rework.

items.title: Built‑in AI Interpreter for Calls on Teams Phone Devices
items.description: With AI Interpreter, Teams Phone Devices provide real‑time language interpretation directly within the call experience. Users can participate naturally in multilingual conversations while the device interprets spoken audio, reducing language barriers and supporting clearer communication in everyday calling scenarios. Updated September 22, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. A planned future release will be communicated separately once timelines are available.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
items.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.
